newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU buys 21,240 tonnes beef into intervention stores.
newsitem.headline: EU buys 21,240 tonnes beef into intervention stores.

text.p: The European Union's beef management committee approved the purchase of 21,240 tonnes of beef into intervention stores, a European Commission official said on Friday.
"The maximum price was set at 249 ecus a kilo", the official added.
The committee accepted all Irish tenders amounting to 4,664 tonnes because of the market situation affecting the Irish beef industry, the official added.
